home.title: Novels enter the stage here
home.summary: A restrained adaptation workspace for authors: understand first, then adapt, with every AI judgment carrying source, status, and review markers.
home.sourceText: Chapter 3, paragraph 18: She stops outside the door and hears someone lower their voice to mention the old case.
home.scriptText: INT. STUDY DOORWAY - NIGHT. She grips the handle, then stops. Rain cuts the voices inside into fragments.
home.note: AI-added staging is marked so the author can confirm it scene by scene.

placeholder.note: This feature is still planned; the page is a routing-scaffold placeholder.

import.title: Import & Preprocessing
import.description: Paste or upload TXT/DOCX novels, split by chapter, and validate at least 3 chapters before continuing.

analysis.title: Understanding & Character Profiles
analysis.description: Generate editable story understanding, character profiles, author intent, and adaptation direction—understand first, then adapt.

outline.title: Scene Outline
outline.description: Generate a per-scene outline with source_ref bindings; add, remove, reorder, and edit fields.

script.title: Screenplay Generation
script.description: Translate the outline into a YAML screenplay: externalization, dialogue scripting, added-content flags, and line-level sourcing.

editor.title: Editing Workbench
editor.description: Side-by-side source vs. screenplay, scoped regeneration, WYSIWYG editing, and TODO markers.

report.title: Adaptation Report
report.description: Summarize kept/cut/merged/added/externalized changes, consistent with screenplay flags, each traceable to the source.

settings.title: Project Settings
settings.description: Privacy and no-training commitment, shot-hint defaults, storage region, and other project-level settings.
